verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents native bulk import from many 2FA apps, including 2FAS, Aegis, andOTP, Bitwarden, Google Authenticator, LastPass, Proton and Raivo. Its product page advertises "Bulk import from other 2FA apps", and a community user reports that moving from Aegis by export and import was very easy. missing for 10: native import for some providers (Authy needs an external conversion step to Ente's plaintext format; Microsoft Authenticator still requires scanning each QR code by hand).

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: Ente Auth natively supports imports from many 2FA providers.
This switch (export and import) was very easy.
